name: Crypt of Remembrance
summary: The Crypt of Remembrance is an underground burial site situated in the southern reach of Havenshire in the Eastern Plaguelands. Resting just outside the defensive walls of New Avalon, it serves as a solemn resting place now shadowed by the nearby forces contesting the region.

sections.title: A Resting Place in the Enclave
sections.body: Positioned just south of the pastoral plots of the Havenshire Farms and north of New Avalon's boundary, the Crypt of Remembrance was built to house the dead of the surrounding settlements. Like much of the eastern lands, its peaceful purpose is continually threatened by the devastation wrought across the Plaguelands and the encroaching horrors of the undead.

faq.q: Where is the Crypt of Remembrance located?
faq.answer: It is located in the southeastern reaches of the Eastern Plaguelands, sitting in southern Havenshire between the local farmsteads and the exterior perimeter wall of New Avalon.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this crypt?
aliases: why is it called crypt of remembrance
faq.answer: It was established as a formal burial vault for the local human population residing in the nearby township and farms, providing a peaceful resting ground for the honored deceased before regional conflicts escalated.

faq.q: Why are crypts like this fortified in the Plaguelands?
faq.answer: Throughout the Plaguelands, underground crypts and mausoleums face constant peril from necromancy and desecration. Sites like this require vigilance to prevent the buried dead from being disturbed or raised into undeath.

angles.text: For humans of Lordaeron, burial vaults such as the Crypt of Remembrance represent the fragile remnants of peaceful tradition and civic order amidst a kingdom torn apart by plague.
Priests view hallowed crypts as places demanding sacred respect, where blessings of the Light are vital to protect departed souls and their earthly remains from desecration.
